short: Giovanni Bellini, the Venetian Renaissance painter.
note: Giovanni Bellini (c. 1435–1516), a leading Venetian painter. His portrait of Doge Leonardo Loredan, made around 1501–1502, shows the elected ruler of Venice in ceremonial brocade and a distinctive horned cap.
